pm_active.meaning: executeHedge is called with PM active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset token

accounting_reads_succeed.meaning: accounting reads and yield settlement calls (totalBackingSigned, surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) complete without reverting

assumptions: executeHedge is the operation that registers the spot asset in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply.
The accounting reads and yield settlement calls are the ones enumerated in accounting_reads_revert.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish the spot asset token identity or that no reserve existed before the call beyond the conditional 'if no reserve exists'; the no-reserve scenario is treated as the selected precondition.
Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether the caller is unauthorized; not needed for this liveness claim.

limitations: Recovery via removeSuppliedEntry is described but not shown to be executed; permanence of the bricking is not formalized.
The impact is represented as a Boolean completion outcome because the report gives no numeric definition for the accounting reads.
